item.title: Blog Creation
item.description: Starting a Blog I’ve been looking to start a blog for a few months, but I’ve spent most of that time puttering about without actually doing anything. I’ve spent altogether too many hours looking at Drupal vs Wordpress, looking into hosting options, reading documentation and articles. What finally pushed me over the edge was an article I read on a blog written using it. It looked nice, even on mobile, and the way the author talked about it made it sound reasonably painless to set up.
